Protests in Delhi Demand Statehood for Jammu and Kashmir

Hundreds of people protested in Delhi, demanding the restoration of statehood for Jammu and Kashmir. CPM leader Tarigami expressed support for the protest and reiterated the demand. The demonstration highlights ongoing calls for political changes in the region.
